name: Raúl Mendoza
bio:
Raúl's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the racetrack but in his grandfather's auto repair shop in Guadalajara. There, amidst the fumes and the clang of tools, he developed an innate understanding of vehicle mechanics. His fascination with composite materials ignited during a university project focused on lightweighting race car chassis. He pursued advanced certifications in composite engineering and secured internships with local racing teams before landing a coveted position at Full Time Sports. 

Raúl is known for his meticulous approach to composite repair and fabrication. He believes in blending traditional techniques with innovative solutions, constantly seeking ways to enhance the performance and durability of the team's components. His detail-oriented nature, coupled with his experience, makes him an invaluable asset to the team. He takes pride in his work and views each repair as an opportunity to refine his craft and contribute to the team's success.

What sets Raúl apart is his ability to visualize complex composite structures and identify potential weaknesses before they become critical failures. His passion for precision and his dedication to continuous improvement make him a standout composite technician in the competitive world of motorsport.
